block.title: Squall Steed storm-mounted documentation plate
block.positive: Boss bestiary documentation art, ultrawide horizontal arcade shoot-up plate, ultra-detailed large-format 16-bit-inspired concept rendering: the complete machine of Squall Steed SS-05, a vast plate-and-cable seahorse fortress-ship of the Iron Tide, shown full-body broadside and fully readable while riding a horizontal river of storm cloud — the seahorse silhouette explicit: arched neck plating, helmet-crown snout, coiled cable tail uncurling behind trailing lightning, dorsal sail of taut canvas-steel rippling. Its chest stands open, three great breastplate doors hinged outward around a white-blue electrical heart that flashes with each thunderclap. Slanting rain streaks the whole frame, saw-tooth cloud ridges below, violet ambient light with pink bullet-glints along the mane rods. Deep-navy sky never pure black, no foreground characters, no text, no letters, no UI. Bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, subtle CRT scanline glow, clean vector shapes with pixel-art texture accents.

block.notes: Naming the seahorse anatomy parts (arched neck, coiled tail, dorsal sail) stops models from drawing a land horse; open chest doors are the weak-point read.
